function.arguments: {"command":"cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && sed -n '1,240p' build.sh && cd c-blosc2 && ls -la | sed -n '1,80p' && grep -n \"BUILD_FUZZ\" -R CMakeLists.txt cmake tests/fuzz README_FUZZER.md 2>/dev/null | head -50"}
function.name: execute_bash

content:
cmake . -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="$CFLAGS" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="$CXXFLAGS" -DBUILD_FUZZERS=ON
make clean
make -j$(nproc)
zip -j $OUT/decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip compat/*.cdata
find . -name '*_fuzzer' -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
find . -name '*_fuzzer.dict' -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
find . -name '*_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip' -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'total 200
